topic.readerProblem: Buyers who find Goodie AI's $399/month entry price too high or too heavy need cheaper or simpler alternatives matched to the job (baseline, tracking, or managed program).
topic.connection: AEOeye's free audit and $29 report serve the baseline job; the page routes readers to trackers or Goodie itself when ongoing monitoring or a managed program fits better.

assessment: The page replaces an outdated Goodie story (Explorer plan, quote-only Pro, money-back guarantee) with Goodie's live pricing, including the annual-versus-monthly toggle, and compares four alternatives on entry price, engines and capacity from each vendor's own pricing page. It adds a cost-per-answer check using only vendor-defined units, flags assumptions, and does not claim hands-on use, rankings or outcomes for any product.

sources.supports: Core $399, Pro $999, Growth $275 (annual rate); monthly toggle $478.80/$1,198.80/$330; engines, prompts, seats per tier; 7-day Core trial; Enterprise by demo; no refund terms stated.
Free Agent Site Audit: 8 categories, 36 signals, scans robots.txt, llms.txt, schema; does not test what AI says about a brand.
Lite $29/month (15 prompts, four engines), 15% annual discount, Claude/Gemini/AI Mode add-on prices, free trial without stated length.
Starter $95/month, 50 prompts, choose 3 models, 4,500 monthly AI answers, 15% annual discount, Claude only under Enterprise, Start free trial button.
Free Essential with $25 credit (300 credits); Starter $295/month ($245 annual), 3,600 credits, 1 credit = 1 AI response, 11 models incl. Claude.
For-brands tab lists only a free 7-day trial (50 prompts daily, three engines) and custom Enterprise.
Goodie describes a research, monitor, action, measure closed loop.

checks: Writer (Sonnet): fetched each cited URL on 2026-10-03; where pages render prices with JavaScript (Goodie, Peec, Otterly, AthenaHQ) read the rendered page in a real browser and the raw HTML or JS, and kept only what they state.

Writer (Sonnet): recomputed cost-per-answer figures from vendor-defined units (Peec 50 x 3 x 30 = 4,500; Athena 3,600 credits) and marked the Goodie 18,000-answer figure as our assumption.

Writer (Sonnet): checked benchmark and crawler-study numbers against the evidence pack and kept their caveats; did not use the old Goodie, Profound and Nightwatch figures that current vendor pages no longer show.
